scripts.setup: cd app/backend && uv sync && cd ../.. && npm --prefix app/frontend install
scripts.ci: npm run ci:backend && npm run ci:frontend
scripts.ci:backend: cd app/backend && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy core config && uv run python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run && uv run python manage.py check_db_drift && uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest
